purpose: Broaden Featherless model research without searching until a profitable-looking backtest appears. A candidate may only advance if it clears every frozen robustness and multiple-testing gate before the untouched Sep 1-3 holdout is loaded.

information_boundary.reason: Prior ClockCross work found retrospective Alpaca REST news did not faithfully recreate the live MCP company-news context.

prior_correction_model.purpose: Fresh return series for the multiple-hypothesis correction universe; this model is not eligible for Phase-2 promotion because Phase-1 already rejected production authority.

contract_screen.required_action_consistency: 3/3 identical action within every synthetic context

policy_families.individual_direct_replacement: Each contract-qualified model supplies the continuation/reversion/abstain action while the incumbent company-news veto remains non-overridable.
policy_families.individual_incumbent_consensus: Trade only when the incumbent and contract-qualified Featherless model agree on a non-abstain action.

fixed_frontier_ensemble.availability_rule: All five frozen members must clear the contract screen and complete the historical selection.
fixed_frontier_ensemble.round_rule: For each of five repeated rounds, at least three of five models must agree on the same non-abstain action; otherwise that round abstains.
fixed_frontier_ensemble.episode_stability: At least four of five ensemble rounds must yield the same action.
fixed_frontier_ensemble.execution_latency_proxy: Maximum constituent latency, corresponding to a future parallel implementation rather than sequential sum.

probability_of_backtest_overfitting.method: CSCV-style six contiguous blocks using candidate policy mean return as the ranking statistic

references: Halbert White, A Reality Check for Data Snooping, Econometrica 68(5), 2000
Bailey et al., The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
Bailey and Lopez de Prado, The Deflated Sharpe Ratio

untouched_holdout.sep2_rule: Residual below 1% remains deterministic threshold abstain.
untouched_holdout.sep3_rule: Recorded production company-news veto remains non-overridable.
untouched_holdout.pass_rule: All holdout model actions must be stable and candidate mean policy return must be at least incumbent mean policy return.

post_holdout_required_before_production: honest historical option-price/trade-proxy monetization replay using only actually available historical data
provider/runtime soak including schema-failure rate, latency, retry/failure behavior, restart/idempotency, and competition-environment dry run
manual inspection of why the candidate wins
separate explicit approval for any production-policy change

budget.reserve_goal_after_research_usd: at least 5-10 when account balance permits

fallback: Cloudflare Llama remains the authoritative adjudicator; Featherless GLM-5.3 remains a non-blocking shadow/model-risk observer; all deterministic risk and execution policy remains unchanged.
